info.title: plat
info.description: Plat — catalogs the .NET and Angular projects in a repository, with ownership and boundaries, as Markdown.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Plat — Project Catalog for .NET and Angular repositories

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Scan the repository and write the project catalog Markdown.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path to the repository to scan (defaults to the enclosing git repository).

options.name: --output
options.description: Markdown file path, relative to the repository root.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Logging verbosity: quiet, minimal, normal, detailed, diagnostic.
